name: Hanuman Sitting on His Coiled Tail
visual_description: Lord Hanuman seated atop a tall stack of his own coiled tail inside Ravana's court in Ramayan.
usage_context: Used to represent creating one's own high status, asserting dominance, or self-elevation when excluded.

example.top_text: WHEN THEY DON'T OFFER YOU A SEAT AT THE TABLE
example.bottom_text: SO YOU BUILD YOUR OWN THRONE

text_areas.description: Setup describing exclusion or lack of respect
Punchline about asserting dominance or self-reliance
